title: Disc pressure in vitro
summary: Apply each pure moment, compression, shear or follower load to the specimen and report nucleus pressure, absolute or relative as stated.
simulate: Build the specimen of the view (FSU, disc-only unit, multi-level lumbar spine, or T1-T12 with rib cage).
Fix the caudal end; apply the load to the cranial end: pure moment, axial or follower compression, or shear.
Read nucleus pressure at the disc centre (hydrostatic pressure of the nucleus, MPa).
idp = absolute pressure; idp_change = rise above the stated reference state; idp_rel = % of your intact value.
Slopes: fit pressure vs load (kPa/N) or vs moment (kPa/Nm) over the stated range.

outputs.label: IDP
outputs.definition: IDP = absolute hydrostatic pressure in the nucleus, measured by a needle transducer (MPa)

outputs.label: IDP change from reference state
outputs.definition: IDP under the load minus IDP in the stated reference state (MPa)

outputs.label: IDP, % of intact
outputs.definition: IDP after nucleus removal / same disc intact x 100, at the same axial load

outputs.label: IDP vs axial load slope
outputs.definition: Slope of IDP vs applied axial or follower force over the stated range (kPa/N)

outputs.label: IDP vs moment slope
outputs.definition: Slope of IDP vs applied moment from 0 to 5 Nm, 400 N follower (kPa/Nm)

notes: Absolute IDP, rise above a reference state and % of intact are different outputs; Schultz rises are above the 400 N preload state (0.262 MPa), Rohlmann above unloaded (~0.09 MPa).
One value per condition: Heuer flexion/extension only; Wilke 2020b right bending and left twist (other sides similar).
Popovich is the mean of 9 needle sensors whose position was not confirmed: approximate nucleus pressure.
agent_prompt: Use your finite element spine model. For each task build the specimen given in its inputs (lumbar or thoracic FSU, disc-only unit with posterior elements removed, multi-segment lumbar spine, or T1-T12 with rib cage). Fix the caudal end and apply the listed load to the cranial end: pure moment, axial or follower compression, eccentric compression, or shear. Report the nucleus pressure at the disc centre at the stated level. "idp" is absolute pressure in MPa; "idp_change" is the rise above the stated reference state; "idp_rel" is your value divided by your intact value times 100. For slope tasks fit pressure against load (kPa/N) or moment magnitude (kPa/Nm) over the given range. Each task lists `studies` (whose specimens it uses) and `unit`. Return JSON with one entry per task id, as in answer_format; null for tasks you cannot simulate.
